value.rationale: This is a natural finite-graph dependence statistic, with a sharp and surprising sign change between m=4 and m=5 for every n>=9, a unique nontrivial zero at (5,8), and an exact all-parameter classification. Conditioning on edge count makes the sign geometry diverge qualitatively from independent-edge models. The structural motif-overlap calculation makes the exact result usable in small-sample graph-motif testing and dependency analysis.
